newsitem.title: UK: Israel to launch swimmers from submarine - report.
newsitem.headline: Israel to launch swimmers from submarine - report.

text.p: Israel has started sea trials of a submarine that can launch commando swimmers while still submerged, a leading defence review said on Thursday.
Jane's Fighting Ships said the conning tower of the latest model of the Dolphin class submarine had been adapted as an exit and entrance for Special Service divers.
"Wet and dry" compartments below the conning tower had space for up to eight men, it said.
Their backup equipment and vehicles could be launched through specially adapted torpedo tubes.
Jane's said the first of three submarines being built in Germany would be delivered to the Israeli port of Haifa next summer.
